Market today: Oil is the clear driver, up 7% on geopolitical fears. This usually spooks the market and hits tech/chip names hard, which is exactly what we're seeing.

Your holdings: QQQ (-6.53%), QQQI (-8.73%), SMH (-19.81%), and SOXL (-62.44%) are all marked SELL. SOXL is leveraged and decaying, making its deep loss even more concerning. SPAL (-54.75%) is also leveraged and needs attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil price action and any follow-through in tech.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech book is under pressure from macro events; manage risk on leveraged names.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; these leveraged ETFs amplify drawdowns.
Consider trimming QQQ and QQQI given their SELL status and negative PnL.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
